title: Find a group: community profiles
summary: Dungeon Masters and players can make a community profile and find each other in the new Find a group directory.
items: My account has a Community profile: choose a handle, whether you DM, play or both, your games, time zone, play times, a looking-for-group note and an optional Discord username.
Profiles are hidden until you choose who can see them: signed-in members, or everyone including search engines. Email addresses are never shown.
Find a group lists profiles you can filter by role, what people are looking for, game, time zone and name.
Signed-in members can report a profile, and site staff can hide one.
